sources.title: Qwopus 3.8 27B Flash NVFP4: Native Blackwell AI Breakthrough
sources.snippet: A native NVIDIA ModelOpt NVFP4 conversion of Qwopus3.8-27B-Flash has been released on HuggingFace, specifically engineered for NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs. Featuring a strategic mixed-precision design that keeps the language model head, vision encoder, and speculative heads in BF16, this 27.78B parameter model sets a new standard for high-speed inference without loss of output accuracy.
